decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build on the firm's established dental lab materials and thermoforming capabilities, so absorptive capacity supports learning and improvement.
PETG thermoforming blank draws on existing dental material and custom-device knowledge, enabling the firm to interpret results and refine it.
UV-curing lacquer is related to the firm's materials and digital dental workflows, though less central than thermoforming, so the firm can still assimilate and improve it.
Custom hearing protection earmolds leverage the firm's custom earmold manufacturing and hearing-care channel relationships, fitting its existing knowledge base.
